name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: A record of what happened and what is planned, read top to bottom: events on an engraved rail, each a lamp with the LED meanings (off for the past, green now, amber waiting, red failed) and its word, a running event's ring on the Spinner's clock, and a now marker where the past meets the plan. Times in tabular figures, relative with the exact time in a tooltip, at the end of the line or in a column before the rail; durations; the host's glyphs in sunk wells with the state's lamp on the corner. New events land from above and the rest glide.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/timeline.md. SwiftUI: MetalTimeline in the MetalUI Swift package.
